content.value: Given a singly linked list, write a program to split it into two sub-lists one for the front half, (11) and one for the back half. If the number of elements is odd, the extra element should go in the front list.
You should check your solution against a few cases (length of the list = 2, 3, 4) to make sure that the list gets split correctly near the short-list boundary conditions.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
